headline.zh: 为自主机器人规划室内导航方案
headline.en: Plan indoor navigation for autonomous robot

scenario.zh: 在GPS信号受阻的仓库环境中，为自主搬运机器人选择合适的导航传感器配置
scenario.en: Select navigation sensor configuration for autonomous warehouse robot where GPS signals are blocked

instruction.zh: 确定机器人的主要工作场景
instruction.en: Identify the robot's primary work scenario

output.zh: 环境特征：多层金属结构阻挡GPS，需要高精度惯性定位，行进路径复杂且重复
output.en: Environment: multilayer metal blocks GPS, requires high-precision inertial positioning, complex repeated paths

output.zh: 环境特征：完全无GPS信号，照明条件变化大，需要持续准确的姿态跟踪
output.en: Environment: complete GPS blackout, varying lighting, requires continuous accurate attitude tracking

instruction.zh: 根据精度需求选择IMU配置方案
instruction.en: Choose IMU configuration based on accuracy needs

output.zh: 配置特点：紧凑封装内实现光纤级精度，漂移率更低，适合长时间无参考点运行
output.en: Configuration: fiber-optic grade accuracy in compact package, lower drift, suits long reference-free operation

output.zh: 配置特点：体积小成本低，但漂移较快，需要频繁使用视觉或标记点校准位置
output.en: Configuration: smaller and cheaper, but faster drift, requires frequent visual or landmark calibration

instruction.zh: 评估两种方案在相同路径下的表现
instruction.en: Evaluate both solutions on identical path

label.zh: 光子陀螺：10分钟连续运行

output.zh: 位置误差保持在厘米级，姿态稳定，返回起点偏差小，无需中途重定位
output.en: Position error stays centimeter-level, stable attitude, minimal return-to-origin drift, no mid-path relocation needed

output.zh: 位置误差逐渐累积至分米级，姿态有偏移，需每隔几分钟通过二维码校准
output.en: Position error accumulates to decimeter-level, attitude drifts, requires QR code calibration every few minutes

instruction.zh: 选择最终导航配置并记录决策
instruction.en: Select final navigation configuration and document decision

output.zh: 决策记录：在GPS拒止环境中实现持续高精度定位，减少辅助传感器依赖和维护成本
output.en: Decision: achieve sustained high-precision positioning in GPS-denied environment, reduce auxiliary sensor dependency and maintenance

output.zh: 决策记录：通过增加视觉定位标记点和更频繁校准，以较低硬件成本满足基本导航需求
output.en: Decision: meet basic navigation needs at lower hardware cost by adding visual landmarks and more frequent calibration

takeaway.zh: OSCP光子陀螺在紧凑尺寸内提供光纤级精度，适合GPS信号受限的自主导航场景
takeaway.en: OSCP photonic gyroscopes deliver fiber-optic grade accuracy in compact size, suited for GPS-denied autonomous navigation
